hypothesis: At least 20% aggregate correction-count reduction on 60 paired drift/coupling seeds.
H: Online local Jacobian adaptation reduces paired observe/action corrections by at least 20% on held-out gain-drift/cross-coupling trials versus fixed gain, with same goal outcomes and zero safety violations.
T: One paired finite run: 30 seeds each for constant, gain drift, cross-coupling, and saturation; 120 seed-condition pairs, two arms each. Independent auditor reconstructs from raw action/event rows and separately regenerates the hidden plant.
tests: 30 paired seeds in each of constant, run-wise gain drift, moderate cross-coupling, and saturation; baseline and adaptive arms share start state, observations, action/observation schedule, target tolerance and action norm bound.
decision: PASS_METHOD_SCOPED only with complete 120 pairs, independent raw replay with zero errors, all paired arms reaching identical independently scored goals, >=20% fewer corrections on the 60 drift/coupling pairs, and zero safety violations. Otherwise FAIL_NO_GAIN or HOLD_AUDIT_OR_OUTCOME.
D: As in decision; any missing pair, goal mismatch, unsafe action, or audit error holds/fails the gate; valid runs under threshold are FAIL_NO_GAIN.
controls: fixed-gain arm on every paired seed
independent hidden-plant reconstruction and forged-terminal mutation
C: Matched fixed-gain arm and shared paired states; constant-gain, saturation, stale-binding, and missing-ack controls.
uncertainties: Finite authored simulator and feature oracle are cleaner than GUI evidence; no real interface, target tracking, delayed animation, semantic task success, human tempo, or generalization is tested. No live input authority is used.
U: Only the authored finite two-dimensional synthetic plant and tested gain/coupling ranges; no empirical GUI/control efficacy or transfer claim.
execution: Candidate and auditor each once after this freeze. Construction tests are not formal results. OrbStack image-store failure documented in protocol; host execution is an explicit runtime deviation and carries no timing/resource claim.
